comment: Kiln clients: CraftableAmount is a type-1 RecipeApply dry-run STATUS, not a count (GitHub #132). The exact call below always rolls back. Its descriptor (tx+0xb0 = 0x40, | 0x08 at a workshop; C 0x2bd88b, 0x2bdda4) makes RecipeApply pay it with RecipePayAlt (C 0x3f9700), not InventoryPay: mode 0 takes the owner's whole line (return 0x3f9777), mode 2 subtracts the client stock table (C 0x4709a0: bases + 0x1610) and takes the rest from the owner (return 0x3f98a3). Only that payer's material shortfall may use per-ingredient server stock to continue the preview; native eligibility/water/output guards and authoritative server payment are unchanged. Since 0.2.0-dev.31.12.

stations/client.CraftAltTakeRet.comment: RecipePayAlt mode 0: PayMaterial(out, tx, owner, item, multiplier x count)'s return (client 26430625 0x3f9777)

stations/client.CraftAltStockRead.comment: RecipePayAlt modes other than 0: the client stock table getter's call on tx+0x68 (bases) and its return (0x3f97d4); captures stations/client.CraftStockTable (0x4709a0: lea rax,[rcx+0x1610]; ret)

stations/client.CraftAltStockTakeRet.comment: RecipePayAlt modes other than 0: PayMaterial for what the client stock table does not cover; its return (0x3f98a3)
